premises.text: Players can earn credit for engaging with their favorite websites.
premises.evidence_span: One True Fan is a service that gives players credit for showing love at their favorite websites

premises.text: Publishers want to better engage their most loyal users.
premises.evidence_span: Our customers are publishers who want to better engage their most loyal users.

premises.text: The service can be integrated easily into websites through JavaScript.
premises.evidence_span: publishers can install a bit of JavaScript and immediately have their entire user base playing the game

premises.text: Users can earn points for various activities on the web.
premises.evidence_span: I'm going to check in right now, get 10 points for that, and then each additional page that I view today, I'm going to get another point.

premises.text: True fans engage differently and contribute significantly to page views.
premises.evidence_span: these regulars, these true fans, engage with their favorite sites differently

premises.text: Companies are currently focused on attracting one-shot traffic rather than engaging true fans.
premises.evidence_span: companies are spending millions of dollars every month engaged in SEO and social media optimization so that they can get more of this crappy one-shot traffic.

premises.text: The service will offer tangible rewards for user engagement.
premises.evidence_span: moving forward, we'll be offering tangible rewards for engagement.

premises.text: Partnerships with premier sites will create opportunities for brokering deals.
premises.evidence_span: we don't need to have millions of installs in order to make this happen because each premier site that we partner with is another opportunity to start brokering those deals.

value.text: Users can be recognized and rewarded for their loyalty and engagement with websites.
value.evidence_span: We give them credit, give players credit for their activities, and give them a bit of good-natured gameplay.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded as premises.
